purpose: Test whether a uniform-training baseline can learn the P41 v2 task in a non-saturated, non-collapsed band before any proposed method exists.

method.name: UTR-P41-reference
method.intervention: uniform sampling over the frozen training scenario tape only

training.sampling: balanced by scenario family and forecast-reliability band

validation.access: evaluation only; never used in an optimizer step or sampling decision

final.access: sealed until all three endpoint checkpoints exist
final.reporting: training seed is the independent unit

baselines.random_legal: samples only legal action indices without future realization access
baselines.oracle: audit-only upper comparator; not a fair policy baseline

T4_gate.nominal_learning: At least two of three UTR seeds exceed the matched random-legal mean completed-service value on the final tape.
T4_gate.noncollapse: At least two of three UTR seeds obtain nonzero completed-service value in each pressure family; no pressure family has all UTR and rule policies at zero.
T4_gate.nonsaturation: At least one pressure family remains below the audit oracle mean completed-service value for every UTR seed.
T4_gate.behavioral_use: Across final-tape episodes, each passing UTR seed uses both service sites and at least one relay reconfiguration in a legal trajectory.
T4_gate.decision: Pass only if every criterion holds. Otherwise emit P41_V2_T4_STOP and prohibit method design.

claim_boundary: A pass establishes only baseline learnability and task-band suitability. It does not establish a MARL contribution, robustness claim, or method innovation.
